svg.title: The Orrery — a brass clockwork of the solar system
svg.desc: Mercury through Neptune in true relative orbital periods, driven by meshing brass change wheels, with a day/night terminator sweeping each turning planet.

g.text: machine of the world · brass, steel & time
TRAIN — ONE TURN OF THE RUNNER = ONE YEAR
spin: 1 sidereal day = 2.2 s (axial ratios true)
mesh: pitch radii ∝ teeth · runners counter-run
neptune's hand has not moved for three minutes.
HOROLOGIVM MVNDANI · PER VERAS PERIODORVM RATIONES
eight planets · true relative periods · compound change wheels
day and night cast across every turning ball
